header.title: Timeline
header.description: Vertical chronological history for orders, activity or logs. Pass events in `items`, and each one can have a title, description, time, icon, tone and extra content. `pending` appends an in-progress event at the end.

placed.title: Order placed
placed.description: Checkout completed. Waiting for payment confirmation.

paid.title: Payment received
paid.description: Visa ending in 4242. Receipt sent to billing@acme.test.

packed.title: Packed at the warehouse
packed.description: Two items, one box. Tracking appears once it ships.

fail.title: Deploy failed
fail.description: The preview environment timed out during migration.

ok.title: Checks passed
ok.description: Lint, types and visual snapshots are green.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the Timeline and the code.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Each event needs a stable `id`. `title`, `description` and `time` are optional. Pass `listLabel` to name the list.

icons.title: Icons and content
icons.description: `icon` replaces the dot with an icon inside a circle. `content` adds content below the description, like badges, links or buttons.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` changes the marker color of each event. Color only supports the text: the status must be in the text too.

end.title: End aligned
end.description: `align="end"` puts the text on the left and the rail on the right.

alternate.title: Alternate
alternate.description: `align="alternate"` zigzags events on both sides of the rail. It needs more width: use it on wide screens.

reverse.title: Reverse order
reverse.description: `reverse` shows the newest event first without changing `items`. It also changes the DOM order and adds `reversed` to the `<ol>`, so screen readers read the same order you see.

pending.title: Pending event
pending.description: `pending` appends an in-progress event with an animated marker. A string is used as its title; `pendingDot` changes the icon. Advance the order to see it change.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. It changes the marker, the spacing and, in `lg`, the title style.

dates.title: Dates and times
dates.description: When `time` is a string, it renders as a `<time>` without `dateTime`. For a machine-readable date, pass your own `<time dateTime>`. Here the date is formatted with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` for the current language.

approved.title: Review approved
approved.description: Two approvals from the platform team.

deployed.title: Deployed to production
deployed.description: 100% of traffic is on the new version.

richTitle.title: Rich title
richTitle.description: `title` accepts any node, like text with a `Badge`. In that case pass `ariaLabel`: otherwise the event is announced as "Event".

release.title: Version released
release.description: New filters in the invoices table.

hotfix.title: Hotfix
hotfix.description: Fixes tax calculation on card payments.

card.title: Inside a card
card.description: With `size="sm"` it fits side panels or activity cards.

header.title: Timeline API
header.description: API reference for the React Timeline: props, event shape, helpers, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Timeline accepts <ol> attributes except children: events are passed with items.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.list: It renders an <ol> with aria-label. listLabel defaults to "Timeline": pass a descriptive, translated name like "Order history".
a11y.order: With reverse, the DOM order matches the visual order and the <ol> gets reversed.
a11y.headings: String titles are <h3>. Place the Timeline under an <h2> so the heading hierarchy makes sense.
a11y.itemLabel: When title isn't a string, the <li> gets aria-label="Event", which replaces all of its content. Pass ariaLabel on every event with a rich title.
a11y.pending: The pending event has aria-busy. With pending={true} it's announced as "Pending" and can't be translated: prefer passing a string.
a11y.time: String times go in a <time> without dateTime. For real dates, pass your own <time dateTime>.
a11y.color: The tone only changes the marker color. Write the status in the title or description.
a11y.icons: The marker, icon and rail have aria-hidden: they're decorative.
a11y.motion: The pending marker pulses and ignores prefers-reduced-motion. Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) with animation: none on .gem-timeline__item--loading .gem-timeline__marker, like these examples do.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.last: Last event. It has no rail line or bottom spacing.
rules.loading: Event with `loading`, like the pending one. The marker pulses.
rules.rail: Column holding the marker and line. Receives `classNames.rail`.
rules.connector: Line to the next event. Receives `classNames.connector`.
rules.title: Title. Receives `classNames.title`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Variables you can override on the root. Marker variables can also be changed per event with `classNames.item`.

items.--gem-timeline-gap: Space between the marker and the line.
items.--gem-timeline-col-gap: Space between the rail and the text. Changes with `size`.
items.--gem-timeline-body-pad: Text padding; sets the spacing between events. Changes with `size`.
items.--gem-timeline-dot: Size of the dot without an icon. Changes with `size`.
items.--gem-timeline-icon-well: Rail column width and icon circle size. Changes with `size`.
items.--gem-timeline-marker-border: Marker border, to separate it from the background.

items.--gem-palette-neutral-{50|300|600}: Text and line in dark mode.
items.--gem-space-{1|2|3|4|5|6}: Spacing between parts and between events.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.items: Events in chronological order, oldest to newest.
items.align: Text side relative to the rail. `alternate` zigzags them.
items.reverse: Shows the newest first. Doesn't change `items`.
items.pending: Appends an in-progress event. `true` shows only the marker; a node is used as its title.

items.id: Stable key. Used as `key` and in the `<li>` `id`.
items.title: Title. A string renders as `<h3>`.
items.time: Time or date. A string renders as `<time>`.
items.icon: Replaces the dot with an icon.
items.content: Extra content: badges, links, buttons or other UI.
items.ariaLabel: Accessible name when `title` isn't a string.

items.hasTimelineNode: Whether a value renders: ignores `null`, booleans and empty strings.
items.itemSide: Text side of an event based on `align` and its position.
items.resolveTimelineItems: Returns the ordered events, with the pending one appended when needed.
